<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Chainsaw" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Update" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Customer decision on first chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Properties" name="Tells properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties" messageRef="Message_Properties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Update" name="Sends updates" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Update"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSaw" name="Sends first chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Sends decision" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Properties" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Properties" messageRef="Message_Properties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrive" name="All parts arrive"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Produce and send updates in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" name="Assemble first chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive customer's decision on first chainsaw" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerDecision" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?" default="Flow_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Task_ProduceRest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRest" name="Produce the rest of the order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductionMerge" name="Merge customer decision paths"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular updates to customer during production" messageRef="Message_Update">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">production is ongoing</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionJoin" name="Wait for production and updates"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConcluded" name="Production concluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Order" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Arrival" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Event_PartsArrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrival_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrive" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Split" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_FirstSaw" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstSaw_Send" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_ReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Produce_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRest" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
